user_preference: All manuscript figures remain ImageGen previews; quantitative plots retained only as checking references.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: manuscript Figure 4, explicitly an ImageGen data-layout PREVIEW. Redesign the attached reference chart as a polished scientific preview, landscape 1536x1024, white background, navy headings, restrained teal/blue/orange/purple colours, crisp readable typography, thin axes, generous margins. The attached image is the scientific content/reference, not a figure to pass off as exact data. Preserve the five-panel scientific organization and broad trends, but make text much shorter and larger. Title "World differences in forecasts and the evidence behind a local relationship".
Top row a,b,c are scatter plots: a "Normalized pH", b "Free dissociation", c "Precipitation". Each horizontal axis "Reference difference (B - A)" and vertical "Forecast difference (B - A)". Keep mostly negative differences with zero included. Reference diagonal is dashed equality, no fitted curve. Reproduce qualitative spread in the attached chart: close agreement in a/c; more dispersed b. Five muted colours denote parameter pairs, no confidence bands. Small annotation beneath top row: "30 research sessions | 1,080 forecasts | 180 correlated contrasts".
Bottom left panel d occupies two thirds: "Study A: observations supporting a local relation". Scatter only, no fitted/smoothed curve. X axis logarithmic nominal concentration in mol/L, ticks 0.01,0.1,1; y axis "Precipitation signal", 0 to 0.10. Twelve observed markers labelled batch 1 through 12, approx follow the supplied reference: batches1-6 blue, batches7-12 orange. Inset legend "1-6: initial sampling" / "7-12: after next-test note". Short text "Denser sampling, repeat, higher loading". Bottom right panel e is three compact stacked text blocks "Physical information: separating observations in 30/30 sessions", "Final forecasts: substantial world differences retained", "Local relation: measured pattern used in later judgments". Bottom note "Prediction sensitivity does not establish unique mechanism identification. No NoResearch arm."
Do NOT say all exact points are shown. Do not claim 30/30 mechanism discovery. Avoid repository filenames, hashes, logos, molecular art, decorative lab glassware, arrows suggesting causal mediation. Mandatory footer in readable grey: "IMAGEGEN PREVIEW | Illustrative geometry; exact values in Supplementary Information". All geometry remains a preview.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: manuscript Figure 5, ImageGen PREVIEW. Redesign the supplied chart into a clean, readable landscape 1536x1024 scientific data-layout preview with four panels a,b,c,d in a 2x2 grid. White background, navy headings, thin grey axes, muted teal blue orange purple pink. Large readable labels. Reference image supplies scientific trends and values; generated dots/lines are illustrative.
Title "Acquiring evidence and using the same research history".
Panel a "Research opportunity: separate groups". Slope-dot plot of mean absolute error for Purity, Size, Recovery, Fines. Left/right in each category = NoResearch / Research. Five world lines with faint individual dots in reference-like spread. Exact aggregate labels above categories respectively "0.139 to 0.017", "0.236 to 0.076", "0.135 to 0.116", "0.377 to 0.301". y axis "MAE". Label "15 sessions per group".
Panel b "Using the same 15 research histories". Separate slope-dot plot: Research agent / Source mean within each category. Aggregate labels respectively "0.017 to 0.004", "0.076 to 0.018", "0.116 to 0.188", "0.301 to 0.292". y axis "MAE". Clear small callout "Alternative prediction rule, not a third experimental group". Purity and size decrease, recovery increases; fines mixed. This panel is NOT next stage after a, no arrows linking a to b.
Panel c "Fines: better points, poorer intervals". Five slope lines for NoResearch / Research, interval score each increases, aggregate "1.479 to 1.805". y axis "80% interval score (lower is better)". Caption inside panel "Point error decreases; interval score worsens".
Panel d "Equilibrium: overall and regional outcomes". Two pairs of conditions NoResearch / Research: "All queries" aggregate "0.132 to 0.036", all5 lines decrease; "Extreme dilution" aggregate "0.061 to 0.104", four lines rise and one falls, as reference. y axis "Normalized macro MAE". Note "Research 14/15; NoResearch 15/15. Missing is not zero."
Shared colour legend W1 W2 W3 W4 W5. Keep sufficient whitespace and no clutter. Curves and points illustrative, no confidence bands, no significance stars, no causal decomposition, no ordered three-arm pipeline. Footer mandatory and readable: "IMAGEGEN PREVIEW | Illustrative geometry; exact values in Supplementary Information".

figure4_margin_correction: Edit this manuscript data-layout PREVIEW only to fix margins and footer. Preserve every panel, scientific statement, axis label, colour, marker and title. Scale the complete existing composition down enough to leave a clean bottom margin of about 70 pixels within the same 1536x1024 landscape canvas. Remove the cropped text at the bottom. In the new margin add this single fully visible centred footer, readable dark grey, with at least 20 pixels beneath it: 'IMAGEGEN PREVIEW | Illustrative geometry; exact values in Supplementary Information'. Do not crop any text. All plotted positions are illustrative preview geometry. No new data, no additional panel, no additional claims.
